packageRules.description: type-plus 8.x is an in-progress major rewrite published only to the `beta` dist-tag; `latest` is 7.x. `ignoreUnstable` alone does not cover this once something is already pinned to a prerelease, so bound it explicitly.
Dev-only updates merge themselves once CI is green.
GitHub Actions minor/patch updates merge themselves.
Runtime dependencies of published packages stay manual: the bump ships to consumers and needs a patch changeset.
Majors stay manual regardless of dep type.
